tools.description: Search the user's files by filename. Returns matching file metadata (including each file's processing status), ranked by name match. Read-only; nothing is written, so it is safe to call.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the user's files by filename and return matching documents in the deep-research result shape. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, query_table · Private data: profile, list_profiles, account, list_files, search_files, search, get_file, fetch, ask_docs, query_table, suggest_update, shared_context · Public sink: get_file, query_table, shared_context · Destructive: info, query_table.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, query_table · Private data: profile, list_profiles, account, list_files, search_files, search, get_file, fetch, ask_docs, query_table, suggest_update, shared_context · Public sink: get_file, query_table, shared_context · Destructive: info, query_table

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
